title: atropis pamirica
intro: Atropis pamirica, commonly known as Himalayan Atropa or Atropis, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is widely used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Himalayan region, to treat various health conditions due to its rich profile of bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Atropis pamirica include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are useful in treating pain, fever, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory activities.
